name: Data Validator API
shortDescription: Deterministic format validation — Luhn cards, IBAN, ISBN, EAN/UPC, ABA routing, E.164, email syntax, JSON
description: Agent-native data-format validator computed with real checksum and syntax algorithms — never an LLM. /validate checks a value against one format (Luhn card numbers, IBAN mod-97, ISBN-10/13, EAN/UPC GTIN, US ABA routing number, E.164 phone, email syntax, or JSON parse) or auto-detects the most likely format. The one-call /lookup also reports which other formats the value satisfies, the detected type, and reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators). Invalid input returns {valid:false, reason} — never a 5xx, never fabricated. Confidence always 1.0.

endpointPricing.description: Validate a value against one format (or auto-detect)
